visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand with well-manicured nails holding a brown and gold makeup brush with soft, red-tipped bristles. The hand dips the brush head into a square-shaped Clio 'Glass Highlighter' palette placed on a marble surface. The environment is a brightly lit bathroom or vanity area featuring a silver Prada box and other high-end skincare bottles in the background. (2) The camera stays static as the hand lifts the brush and presses a small circular button on the handle. The brush head immediately starts to rotate and vibrate at a high speed, causing the bristles to appear as a blur. The luxury cosmetic products remain neatly arranged on the marble-top counter in the background. (3) The hand demonstrates the brush's different operational modes by clicking the power button several times. The vibration pattern shifts from continuous rotation to a rhythmic, pulsing motion. The setting remains constant, showing a clean, well-organized indoor space with high-quality lighting that emphasizes the metallic accents of the brush and the products. (4) The person places the still-vibrating makeup brush horizontally onto the hard marble countertop. The entire visual frame begins to shake violently, and the Clio palette and Prada box rattle intensely against the surface, simulating an earthquake. Large, bold text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen to punctuate the comedic turn.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video starts as a conventional beauty product review or showcase of an electric makeup brush but shifts into a comedic skit. The intent is to entertain viewers by demonstrating the surprisingly high power of the brush's vibration, which creates a mock 'earthquake' effect when placed on a table.
